flux2.default_prompt_prefix_mic: Multi-image composition: describe how to combine the images (e.g. which image is subject, which is background). Keep prompts clear and focused.
flux2.default_prompt_prefix_tti: Text-to-image: include subject, scene, and style. Be specific; add quality cues (e.g. ultra-detailed, dramatic lighting).

flux1_fill.default_prompt_prefix_idwm: Image edit: describe what to add or change in the editable area. Include lighting and style to match the rest of the image.
